default/30735.htm.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Ah, it is always such a pleasure to see a fresh-faced traveler! My name is Sophya. I command the 4th platoon of the Black Lion Mercenary Troop We have been hired by the mayor of the Town of Dion to drive away evil spirits. I fear I underestimated the number of evil spirits…

links.text: "Tell me about the Black Lion Mercenary Troop."
"Tell me about evil spirits in this area."

default/30735-1.htm.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Currently our 3rd platoon, the main force of our mercenary troop is fighting a important battle in Gludio against the Ol Mahum Stragglers. The 2nd platoon has been dispatched to drive out the evil spirits of the Wasteland. Captain Leopold who is stationed in Gludin, is bet…

default/30735-2.htm.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: In the northwest part of the Cruma Marshlands, the marsh stakatos are building their power base. In the northeast part, the exiled ol mahum partisans are encampred. On top of that Enku orcs, tumran bugbears, and delu lizerdmen are waiting for an easy opportunity to plunder…

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30735-01.html.text: Chief Mercenary Sophya: The Map! This is good information. Where did you get it?

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30735-03.html.text: Chief Mercenary Sophya: Did you give my thanks to Waters?

Unfortunately, the bulk of our military has been dispatched to Gludio. At present we are only succeeding in keeping the demons at bay. I will hire every tough-skinned warrior I can get my hands on! Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30735-02.html.text: Chief Mercenary Sophya: Give her my thanks and tell her I'll look after this well!

Q00042_HelpTheUncle/30735-02a.html.text: Chief Mercenary Sophya: Did you give my thanks to Waters?

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-04.htm.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: The time has come for the black lion to pounce! Now, listen carefully. We have four targets to attack: The Execution Grounds, the Fortress of Resistance, the southern shoreline area and the Cruma Marshlands. Since we lack the resources to sustain a prolonged war, we will d…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-05.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Which mission do you wish to learn more about?

links.text: Drive the undead from the Execution Grounds
Drive the Ol Mahum from the Fortress of Resistance
Drive the delu Lizardman from the southern shore area
Kill the marsh stakato in the Cruma Marshlands

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-06.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: The Execution Grounds is located in the east part of the village. It is a haunted place where the never-ending cries of dead souls can be heard. Your mission is to purge that place of the undead that infest it. It is said that those doomed souls are being punished for thei…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-07.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: This mission is to drive the remnants of the Grecian military force from the northwest part of Horseshoe Valley. You must not underestimate these opponents. They are the Ol Mahums of the Bloody Axe army, led by Blood Lord Nurka!

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-08.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: The delu lizardmen were originally stationed by the shore area in the south of Giran. However, lately they have been infiltrating Dion territory. We don't know what they are up to yet, whether it is to find food or to prepare for a large-scale invasion. What is clear is th…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-09.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: We must rid the Cruma Marshlands of the evil stakato. The insect-like stakato is covered with tight scales and is equipped with two sharp forward claws. They are surprisingly quick. You must never underestimate them. To make matters worse, the marshlands are inhabited by g…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-10.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: We must drive out the undead specters, sorrow maidens, neer crawlers, neer ghoul berserkers, strains and ghouls . When an undead is destroyed, it leaves behind a handful of ashes. Bring me back those ashes as proof of your victory. The more ashes of undead that you bring, …

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-11.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: You must defeat the Ol Mahum guerrillas, raiders, marksmen, sergeants and captains . As proof that you have defeated them you must bring back the Bloody Axe Insignia , the symbol of the Partisan army. The more insignias you bring, the greater shall be your reward. Since yo…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-12.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: You must kill the delu lizardmen, including their scouts and warriors . Take care, for although they are similar to the felim and langk lizardmen, they are much more dangerous. As proof of their death you must bring me their teeth . The more of their teeth you bring, the g…

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-13.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: You must go and destroy the marsh stakatos, including their workers, soldiers and drones . As proof of your victory, bring me their claws. The more claws you bring, the greater shall be your reward. Now, prepare for combat and set off for the Cruma Marshlands immediately. …

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-16.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: You must hurry to the battlefield and triumph over your enemies!

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-17a.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Here is the mark of the Lion's Eye . It acknowledges your distinguished service on the battlefield. I am sure your victories will continue!

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-18b.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Here is the mark of the Lion's Eye . It acknowledges your distinguished service on the battlefield. New supplies have been issued to you. These are expendable goods that are essential in combat, you must store and guard them well! I am sure your victories will continue!

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-19b.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: New supplies have been issued for you. Since they are expendable goods that are essential in combat, store and guard them well! I am confident your victories will continue.

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-20.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Even the mightiest lion sleeps. Go to the village and rest. Mercenaries must save their energies for battle.

links.text: "I wish to leave the mercenary troop."

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-21.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Why do you wish to leave the Black Lion troop? Oh well, no need to explain yourself to me, but heed my words... There is no path for you but the one of the warrior. No matter what you do or where you go you are destined for the battlefield. Anyways, if you really want to w…

links.text: "I wish to continue working for the mercenary troop."
"I wish to leave the mercenary troop."

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-24a.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: Ah yes, Redfoot. He is hard to be around but harder to do without. His primary job is the delivery of military supplies, he does business on the side brokering stolen loot and war trophies. He is also a valuable source of information. You should consult with him often.

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-25b.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: This Cargo Box bears the seal of the Aden Traders Guild. If you wish to return it to them, take it to Morgan at the magic grocery store. He works for that guild.

Q00333_HuntOfTheBlackLion/30735-26.html.text: Mercenary Captain Sophya: If you have your mind made up, I won't try to change it. Please return the Black Lion Mark. We are no longer comrades. Here is your pay. Take it and go. Perhaps one day we will draw our swords together again. Good luck!
